gen-gf-bellota-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Hooked, wandering s-ends, drawn with one stylus. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded follows in a plain sans, its curves gaping wide, and over a full page of text it feels modern, open and unhurried.
gen-gf-bellota-ibm-plex-sans: Bellota's s has ends that hang far from its spine, and every curve carries no stress at all. And IBM Plex Sans sits below with a wide channel into each bowl, which makes the pairing feel approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-zilla-slab: Chunky, uniform, unmistakable. Zilla Slab, a sturdy slab-serif with broad openings on its curves, would swallow the heading if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-bellota-text-clash-grotesk: Open shapes, no shading, all attitude. Bellota Text announces each line with confidence, while Clash Grotesk, a sans-serif without any thick-and-thin modulation, carries the body quietly underneath.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-hind: Bellota Text opens wide, with no shading. Hind, a sans-serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, is worth sizing a touch smaller than you would guess, since it already looks big.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Bellota Text draws open shapes without any calligraphic shading, giving headings a bold, distinctive voice. Pilcrow Rounded then reads warmly, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-quicksand: Quicksand's tall bowls, like blown glass bulbs, and its uniform bars make text feel gentle and light, while Bellota Text leads. Their strongest quality is that shared roundness.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alan-sans: Bellota Text looks drawn in neon tube, every stroke consistent. Alan Sans, a plain sans with tails held well back, keeps pages of text feeling modern and easy going.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Commanding, and a bit different. Alegreya Sans SC, a sans with a welcoming gap in its c, keeps a full page feeling contemporary, light and approachable under Bellota Text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-amarna: Bellota Text has open shapes and no shading to guide the eye. Amarna, a sans-serif with contrast-free strokes and unclogged small counters, stays clean and contemporary down a whole page.
